nodes.label: Foretias
nodes.description: Free, Open-source Resilient Time Integrity Attestation Service. Decentralized time-integrity attestation service that cryptographically proves a message existed at a specific tick in a specific calendar.

nodes.label: Chronomatter (Chronos fidelius authenticus)
nodes.description: Autonomous ticking, stamping, verification component. Owns keypair generation, signing, and verification. Each tick has its own Ed25519 keypair; previous private key is disabled when tick advances.

nodes.label: Calendar (Chronos fidelius grapha)
nodes.description: Calendar data, persistence, mutual attestation scheduling component.

nodes.label: Communerd (Chronos fidelius locutus)
nodes.description: All P2P communication component — DHT, gossipsub, peer discovery. Only Communerd communicates with extra-family peers.

nodes.label: TimeFamilyServer (Chronos fidelius adunatrix)
nodes.description: Orchestrator holding Arc<Chronomatter>, Arc<Calendar>, and Option<Arc<Communerd>>, exposing JSON-RPC and HTTP endpoints for stamp, verify, and calendar queries.

nodes.label: Foretis
nodes.description: Cryptographically signed attestation containing message hash, tick number, signature, and the server's unique TBID. Self-contained JSON object.

nodes.label: Tick
nodes.description: Discrete time unit in the Foretias calendar. Each tick has its own Ed25519 keypair. A Foretis stamped at tick n cannot be forged from the past.

nodes.label: Chronon
nodes.description: Time period between ticks, configurable in nanoseconds (default 60s). Controls daemon tick frequency.

nodes.label: TBID (Time-Being ID)
nodes.description: Unique identifier derived from a TimeBeing's public key. Used to identify the server that issued a Foretis stamp.

nodes.label: TBN (Time-Being Name)
nodes.description: Human-readable identifier prefixed with 'tf-' followed by the TBID hex string.

nodes.label: Ed25519
nodes.description: Elliptic curve digital signature scheme via libsodium. Used for per-tick keypairs, stamp signatures, and identity generation.

nodes.label: Noise_XX Protocol
nodes.description: Encrypted handshake protocol for PtP connections between Foretias nodes. Used for stamp/verify RPC over direct TCP.

nodes.label: libp2p
nodes.description: Networking layer for P2P communication. Provides DHT (Kademlia), GossipSub, identify, ping, and request_response protocols with Noise encryption.

nodes.label: Kademlia DHT
nodes.description: Distributed Hash Table for peer discovery with private namespace isolation. Used for auto-discovering peers in the P2P network.

nodes.label: Mutual Attestation
nodes.description: Cross-signing process where peers verify each other's calendar entries. A stamp from one peer becomes verifiable from another through calendar cross-referencing.

nodes.label: External Attestation
nodes.description: Attestation from a peer stored in TickRecord.external_attestations. Verified before storage; unverified attestations are never appended to the calendar.

nodes.label: C11 Core
nodes.description: Verified cryptographic primitives in C11: Ed25519 (libsodium), P-256, SHA-256, BLAKE3, Noise protocol, Merkle trees, FROST, nullifier, RNG mixing, memzero. Builds static lib foretias_core.

nodes.label: foretias-core (core-engine)
nodes.description: Rust crate providing safe wrappers over C11 FFI via bindgen. Contains CryptoServer trait, domain types (tick, foretis, calendar), Chronomatter logic, config, collision, epoch, probity modules.

nodes.label: foretias-node
nodes.description: Rust crate for server and CLI binary. Contains TimeFamilyServer, Communerd (libp2p), calendar store, metrics, probity. Binary entry: serve, stamp, verify, prove-verification, inspect-attestations.

nodes.label: foretias-python
nodes.description: Rust crate for PyO3 Python bindings. Produces foretias-p2p pip package via maturin. Exposes PyForetis, PyTickRecord, PyCalendar, PyTimeFamilyServer, PyCryptoServer.

nodes.label: foretias-java
nodes.description: Rust crate for JNI bindings for Java. Maven package org.foretias:foretias-java:0.2.0.

nodes.label: Python Shim (foretias)
nodes.description: Thin Python re-export layer. CLI entry 'foretis' delegates to Rust via PyO3. Contains cli.py, thin_client.py, _version.py.

nodes.label: CryptoServer Trait
nodes.description: Rust trait abstracting cryptographic operations. SoftwareCryptoServer is the current backend. Keys are in-memory only with zeroize on drop.

nodes.label: PrivKeyHandle
nodes.description: C11 core handle for private keys. Provides zeroize on drop to prevent private-key exfiltration. Tick keypairs regenerated every tick.

nodes.label: DhtPeerSource
nodes.description: DHT-backed peer discovery component. Arc<RwLock<HashMap<PeerId, PeerAddr>>>. MAX_PEERS cap of 256 to prevent DHT eclipse attacks.

nodes.label: EncryptedJsonlCalendarStore
nodes.description: Encrypted calendar persistence format with per-block AEAD authentication tag (ChaCha20-Poly1305). Replaces plaintext JSON format in v0.5.

nodes.label: PeerPool
nodes.description: Manages peer connections and liveness pings. start_liveness_pings() detects dead peers. Daemon tick advances on timer, not peer responses.

nodes.label: JSON-RPC Handlers
nodes.description: Inbound request handlers for stamp, verify, calendar queries. Mitigations: MAX_CONTENT_BYTES (1GB), MAX_CALENDAR_SLICE_COUNT (10000), echo field for replay protection.

nodes.label: start_local_peers.py
nodes.description: Interactive Python peer manager script. Spawns N foretias servers with unique identities, RPC ports, and calendars. Provides REPL for status, stamp, verify, kill commands.

nodes.label: Custom Base64 Display Encoding
nodes.description: Display-only base64 encoding using alphabet [a-zA-Z0-9|_] for JSON output. 64 unique characters, no padding. Internal wire format and storage remain unchanged.

nodes.label: libsodium
nodes.description: C library providing Ed25519 signatures, hashing, and AEAD primitives. Linked by C11 core.

nodes.label: liboqs
nodes.description: Open Quantum Safe library providing post-quantum cryptography: Kyber (KEM), Dilithium (signatures). Integrated via core-engine build.rs.

nodes.label: PyO3
nodes.description: Rust-to-Python binding framework. Used by foretias-python crate to expose Rust functionality to Python via foretias-p2p package.

nodes.label: maturin
nodes.description: Build tool for Rust-Python packages. Produces foretias-p2p pip wheel from foretias-python crate.

nodes.label: bindgen
nodes.description: Rust FFI binding generator. Core-engine build.rs runs bindgen over foretias_core.h to generate Rust bindings for C11 core.

nodes.label: CI Pipeline
nodes.description: GitHub Actions workflow on alpha/mvp branches. Four jobs: c11-tests, rust-tests (needs c11-tests), python-tests (needs rust-tests), lint (parallel). C11 build cached across jobs.

nodes.label: Release Pipeline
nodes.description: GitHub Actions workflow triggered on v* tags. Builds Python package with hatch, checks with twine, publishes to PyPI via trusted publisher or API token.

nodes.label: Network Observer
nodes.description: Attacker with passive read access to all TCP traffic. High impact on JSON-RPC content confidentiality. libp2p transport is encrypted via Noise, so P2P control plane is opaque.

nodes.label: Active Network Attacker
nodes.description: Attacker with full MITM on TCP. Can inject, drop, modify, replay packets. Cannot break libp2p Noise handshake or forge Ed25519 signatures. Medium impact.

nodes.label: Compromised Peer
nodes.description: Legitimate peer with valid keys behaving maliciously. Can send forged requests, refuse to attest, or collude. Medium-high impact. Cross-signature verification limits single-peer damage.

nodes.label: Content Replay Attack
nodes.description: Attacker captures /stamp JSON-RPC response and replays with different content. Mitigated by echo field encoding requester identity + tick number.

nodes.label: Stamp Flood (DoS)
nodes.description: High volume of stamp requests to exhaust CPU or job queue. Mitigated by two-layer rate limit, MAX_JOB_QUEUE_DEPTH=64, timer-driven tick advance.

nodes.label: DHT Eclipse Attack
nodes.description: Attacker controls majority of a node's Kademlia peer table, isolating from honest peers. Mitigated by private namespace key, bootstrap list, MAX_PEERS cap.

nodes.label: Sybil via RNG Failure
nodes.description: Weak or predictable RNG produces colliding TBIDs. Mitigated by rng_mix.c multi-source entropy mixing. v0.7 adds explicit collision detection.

nodes.label: Calendar File Tampering
nodes.description: Disk access modifies plaintext calendar file. Mitigated in v0.5 by EncryptedJsonlCalendarStore with per-block AEAD tag.

nodes.label: Private-Key Exfiltration via Disk
nodes.description: Disk read recovers tick private keys. Mitigated: keys never written to disk, PrivKeyHandle zeroize on drop, keypairs regenerated every tick.

nodes.label: Tick-Rate Exhaustion
nodes.description: Forces victim to advance tick counter rapidly via stamp flood. Mitigated: timer-driven daemon, not stamp-driven. Inbound stamps rate-limited.

nodes.label: PyPI Trusted Publisher
nodes.description: GitHub Actions integration with PyPI. When v* tag pushed, PyPI trusts the GitHub Actions run and publishes without API token. Alternative: PYPI_API_TOKEN secret.

nodes.label: Python-to-Rust Migration (Task 6)
nodes.description: XL effort (40-80 hours) to make Python use ONLY Rust. Current PyO3 bindings are 30% feature-complete. Requires Rust tick rotation, MA signing, daemon, Inquirer, persistence, Config, dormant load, 80+ test rewrites.

nodes.label: C11 Unit Tests (Task 4)
nodes.description: M effort (2-3 hours). 14 test files for all C source files using CMocka. Covers identity, signing, hashing, noise, merkle, FROST, nullifier, RNG, memzero.

nodes.label: Rust Hardening Tests (Task 5)
nodes.description: M effort (1-2 hours). Defensive programming tests: CryptoServer backend, hash functions, Foretis stamp/verify, calendar integrity, error handling, PyO3 bindings.

nodes.label: Fortias to Foretias Rename
nodes.description: Project rename: fortias→foretias, fortis→foretis across two repos. Case-preserving direct string replacement. Affects C sources, Rust sources, Python sources, spec files, CMakeLists, Cargo.toml.

nodes.label: Chrono Chained Attestation
nodes.description: Forward/backward Foretis signatures in each TickRecord form a chained attestation. integrity_check() verifies the chain. A Foretis stamped at tick n cannot be forged from the past.

nodes.label: Resilience / Fault Tolerance
nodes.description: Foretias survives catastrophic network failure. Killing 50% or 90% of peers still allows verification because attestations are replicated via mutual attestation across the decentralized calendar.

nodes.label: GossipSub (Deferred)
nodes.description: P2P message propagation layer planned for v0.6. Not yet shipped. Will include mesh size and flood-publish caps for DoS protection. ProbityReport gossip also deferred to v0.6.

nodes.label: JSON-RPC No TLS (Residual Risk)
nodes.description: JSON-RPC over TCP has no Noise or TLS layer by design. Network observer reads stamp content and calendar queries. Primary threat (content replay) mitigated by echo fields. TLS addition deferred.

nodes.label: test_all (C11 Test Binary)
nodes.description: Single test executable compiling 14 test source files: test_all, test_memzero, test_rng, test_version, test_ed25519, test_sha256, test_merkle, test_nullifier, test_p256_stub, test_blake3_stub, test_noise, test_frost_stub, test_legacy_hash, test_privkey.

nodes.label: C11 Core Source Files
nodes.description: 18 C source files: version, memzero, rng_mix, identity_ed25519, identity_p256, signing_ed25519, signing_p256, hash_sha256, hash_blake3, hash_legacy_insecure_md5, hash_legacy_insecure_sha1, noise_xx, merkle, frost_ed25519, nullifier, privkey.

nodes.label: Chronosidae Taxonomy
nodes.description: Time beings classification: Family Chronosidae, Subfamily Chronosinae, Tribe Chronosini, Subtribe Chronosina, Genus Chronos, Species Chronos fidelius. Subspecies: authenticus (Chronomatter), grapha (Calendar), adunatrix (Time Family), locutus (Communerd).

nodes.description: Center of development. CI runs on push/PR to alpha and mvp branches. Worktree plans merge to alpha.

nodes.label: sccache Build Caching
nodes.description: Rust compilation cache for external crates (libp2p, etc.). Set RUSTC_WRAPPER=sccache. Cannot cache incrementally-compiled workspace members or proc-macros.

nodes.label: CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL
nodes.description: Environment variable for parallel CMake builds of oqs-sys (liboqs). Defaults to CPU count if unset. Without it, foretias-core builds take 15-30 minutes instead of 2-5 minutes.

nodes.label: libp2p Feature Minimization
nodes.description: Enable only required libp2p features (tcp, noise, yamux, gossipsub, kad, identify, ping, request-response) to reduce build time by 20-25%. libp2p has 38 feature flags, none enabled by default.

nodes.label: Two-Layer Identity
nodes.description: libp2p PeerId (transport layer, Noise protocol) + application TBID (Foretias identity). Noise handshake authenticates transport PeerId; application layer verifies Foretias signatures against peer's TBID public key chain.

nodes.label: Daemon Loop
nodes.description: Timer-driven tick advance in Chronomatter. start_daemon() runs on chronon interval, not on peer responses or stamp requests. Provides floor for tick-rate exhaustion mitigation.

nodes.label: Worktree Branch Planning
nodes.description: PLAN.md files document worktree lifecycle: create worktree, implement, verify, merge to alpha, cleanup. Path: ${HOME}/tmp/foretias-worktrees/{SPEC_NAME}_${RANDOM}.

nodes.description: Hierarchy: Major (large feature) > Phase (implementation stage) > Stage (sub-phase) > Step (actionable unit) > Task (small well-defined job). Used for scoping and organization.

nodes.label: copy_from_upstream KEM Jinja2 template
nodes.description: Jinja2 CMake template for generating KEM family build files from algorithm metadata. Handles common deps, scheme implementations, compile flags, CUDA, libjade fragments

nodes.label: copy_from_upstream SIG Jinja2 template
nodes.description: Jinja2 CMake template for generating signature scheme family build files. Handles common deps, implementations, compile flags for AVX2/ARM

nodes.label: BIKE KEM
nodes.description: Bit Flipping Key Encapsulation Mechanism. Levels L1, L3, L5. Round 4 spec with biased sampling. Constant-time QC-MDPC code-based crypto with AVX2, AVX512, PCLMULQDQ, VPCLMULQDQ optimizations

nodes.label: BIKE r4 README
nodes.description: DGK team optimized BIKE implementation. NIST R4 candidate. Constant-time, no secret-dependent branches or memory access. Supports SHA3/SHAKE and BIND_PK_AND_M security flags. Performance benchmarks on Intel Xeon with/without vector-PCLMUL

nodes.label: BIKE GF2X polynomial algebra
nodes.description: Binary polynomial operations for BIKE: inversion, Karatsuba squaring, multiplication, base multiplication. Optimized for AVX2/AVX512/PCLMUL/VPCLMUL

nodes.label: BIKE error vector sampling
nodes.description: Biased sampling for private key and error vectors. Rejection sampling replaced since June 2022 to mitigate timing attacks by Guo et al.

nodes.label: FrodoKEM KEM
nodes.description: Module-LWE based KEM. Variants: 640, 976, 1344 with AES or SHAKE symmetric primitives. AVX2-optimized implementations

nodes.label: Classic McEliece KEM
nodes.description: Code-based KEM. 10 parameter sets (348864 through 8192128) with clean and AVX2 implementations. Uses PQClean reference with AES-256-CTR, Berlekamp-Massey, FFT, syndrome decoding

nodes.label: HQC KEM
nodes.description: Quasi-cyclic code-based KEM. Security levels 128, 192, 256. Clean implementations with FFT, Reed-Muller, Reed-Solomon codes, SHAKE PRF

nodes.label: Kyber KEM
nodes.description: Module-LWE KEM (pre-standardization name). Levels 512 (K=2), 768 (K=3), 1024 (K=4). Reference, AVX2, and AArch64 implementations. NTT, polynomial arithmetic, IND-CPA. Also includes libjade Jasmin implementations

nodes.label: ML-KEM KEM (NIST FIPS 203)
nodes.description: NIST-standardized Module-Lattice KEM (final standard). Levels 512 (K=2), 768 (K=3), 1024 (K=4). Reference C, x86_64 AVX2, AArch64 NEON, and CUDA implementations. NTT-based polynomial arithmetic, IND-CPA, compression, sampling

nodes.label: ML-KEM AArch64 NEON backend
nodes.description: Auto-generated ARM NEON assembly for ML-KEM via SLOTHY superoptimizer. Derived from Neon NTT research by Becker et al. Covers NTT, INTT, polynomial operations, rejection sampling. Used for ML-KEM-512, 768, 1024

nodes.label: ML-KEM x86_64 AVX2 backend
nodes.description: Native x86_64 arithmetic backend from the official Kyber team AVX2 implementation. NTT, base multiplication, rejection sampling, compression

nodes.label: ML-KEM CUDA backend
nodes.description: GPU-accelerated ML-KEM via cupqc library. compute_70 architecture, device link-time optimization

nodes.label: NTRU-Prime KEM
nodes.description: NTRU-Prime sntrup761. Clean and AVX2 implementations with NTT-based polynomial multiplication. Included for interop testing only

nodes.label: CROSS signature scheme
nodes.description: Experimental hash-based signature. rsdp (randomized) and rsdpg (generic) variants at 128, 192, 256 bit security. balanced, fast, small modes. AVX2 optimizations. Common components: merkle trees, seed trees, CSPRNG, signing

nodes.label: Dilithium signature (pre-standardization)
nodes.description: Module-lattice signature (CRYSTALS-Dilithium). Levels 2, 3, 5. Reference, AVX2, AArch64 implementations. NTT, polynomial/vector arithmetic, packing, rounding, randomized signing

nodes.label: PQClean shims
nodes.description: Common shim layer providing FIPS202 (SHA-3) and FIPS202x4 implementations used across all PQClean-based algorithm implementations

nodes.label: Neon NTT research
nodes.description: Research paper: Faster Dilithium, Kyber, and Saber on Cortex-A72 and Apple M1 by Becker, Hwang, Kannwischer, Yang, Yang. Foundation for AArch64 ML-KEM backend

nodes.label: SLOTHY superoptimizer
nodes.description: Constraint-solving based assembly superoptimizer used to generate auditable high-performance assembly from clean source. Part of ML-KEM AArch64 backend pipeline

nodes.label: BIKE BGF decoder
nodes.description: Constant-time QC-MDPC decoder with negligible failure rate. Several shades of gray approach by Drucker, Gueron, Kostic

nodes.label: OQS_ENABLE feature flags
nodes.description: CMake configuration variables controlling which algorithms are compiled. Pattern: OQS_ENABLE_KEM_<family>_<scheme>[_<impl>]. Enables conditional compilation of algorithm object libraries

nodes.label: Kyber libjade Jasmin implementations
nodes.description: Jasmin-verified Kyber implementations via libjade. Constant-time verified assembly for Kyber-512 and Kyber-768, reference and AVX2 variants

nodes.label: OpenSSL dependency
nodes.description: Optional OpenSSL integration for AES, SHA-2, SHA-3. Supports static link or dlopen. Affects common crypto and BIKE implementations

nodes.label: Secure memory clearing
nodes.description: Platform detection for explicit_bzero, explicit_memset, memset_s to ensure secure erasure of sensitive crypto material

nodes.label: Aligned memory allocation
nodes.description: Platform detection for aligned_alloc, posix_memalign, memalign for SIMD-optimized crypto operations requiring aligned buffers

nodes.label: BIKE rejection sampling timing attack
nodes.description: Timing vulnerability in BIKE rejection sampling identified by Guo et al. (TCHES 2022). Mitigated in Round 4 with isochronous biased sampling since June 2022

nodes.label: FALCON Signature Scheme
nodes.description: Lattice-based digital signature scheme using NTT/Fast Fourier Transform over polynomial rings. Variants: 512, 1024, padded_512, padded_1024. Implementations: ref (clean C), avx2 (SSE), aarch64 (NEON/NTT).

nodes.label: MAYO Signature Scheme
nodes.description: Multivariate quadratic signature scheme. Variants: MAYO_1 through MAYO_5. Implementations: opt, avx2, neon. Uses arithmetic, params, api modules.

nodes.label: ML-DSA Signature Scheme
nodes.description: NIST-standardized module-lattice-based digital signature (FIPS 204 / Dilithium). Variants: 44 (level 2), 65 (level 3), 87 (level 5). Implementations: ref (clean C), avx2 (SSE assembly). Core modules: ntt, packing, poly, polyvec, reduce, rounding, sign, symmetric-shake.

nodes.label: SPHINCS+ Signature Scheme
nodes.description: Stateless hash-based signature scheme. Hash variants: sha2, shake. Security levels: 128, 192, 256. Parameter sets: f (fast), s (small). Implementations: clean (ref C), avx2 (SSE). Core modules: address, fors, hash, merkle, sign, thash, utils, wots.

nodes.label: UOV Signature Scheme
nodes.description: Unbalanced Oil and Vinegar multivariate signature scheme. Parameter variants: Is (16/160/64), Ip (256/112/44), III (256/184/72), V (256/244/96). Modes: pkc (public key crypto), skc (secret key crypto). Implementations: ref, neon, avx2. Core modules: blas_matrix, ov, ov_keypair, ov_publicmap, sign, utils_hash, utils_prng.

nodes.label: LMS Stateful Signature
nodes.description: Leighton-Micali hash-based stateful signature scheme. Cisco Systems implementation (MIT licensed). Core modules: hss (hash-based signature scheme), lm (Leighton-Micali OTS), endian, hash. Single-threaded signing.

nodes.label: XMSS Stateful Signature
nodes.description: Extended Hash-Based Signature scheme. Hash functions: sha256, shake128, sha512, shake256. Tree heights: h10, h16, h20. Security variants: _192, _256. XMSSMT (multi-tree) variants: h20_2, h40_2, h40_4, h40_8, h60_3, h60_6, h60_12. Core modules: core_hash, hash_address, params, utils, wots, xmss_commons, xmss_core_fast.

nodes.label: XMSSMT Multi-Tree Signatures
nodes.description: Multi-tree variant of XMSS with parallel tree signing. SHA256 and SHAKE128 hash families. Tree height/arity combinations: h20_2/4, h40_2/4/8, h60_3/6/12.

nodes.label: PQClean Shims
nodes.description: Common include directory providing shim headers used by all PQClean-based signature implementations (FALCON, MAYO, ML-DSA, SPHINCS+, UOV). Standardizes API across PQClean implementations.

nodes.label: liboqs Test Suite
nodes.description: Comprehensive test infrastructure: KEM tests (example, kat, test, test_mem, speed, vectors), SIG tests (example, fuzz, kat, test, test_mem, speed, vectors), SIG_STFL tests (kat, test, speed). Optional Valgrind-based constant-time detection. Python pytest harness with parallel execution.

nodes.label: Constant-Time Test Detection
nodes.description: Valgrind-based detection of non-constant-time behavior in cryptographic operations. Enabled via OQS_ENABLE_TEST_CONSTANT_TIME option. Incompatible with non-debug builds.

nodes.label: Fuzz Testing
nodes.description: LLVM libFuzzer-based fuzzing for signature APIs. Enabled with OQS_BUILD_FUZZ_TESTS and Clang compiler. Target: fuzz_test_sig.

nodes.label: Known Answer Tests
nodes.description: KAT (Known Answer Tests) for KEM, SIG, and SIG_STFL algorithms. Validates implementations against NIST-standard test vectors. Includes intermediate value vector tests.

nodes.label: Zephyr RTOS Port
nodes.description: liboqs integration as Zephyr RTOS module. Kconfig-based algorithm selection. Supports 32-bit ARM, 64-bit ARM, x86, x86_64, Native Posix architectures. Requires custom RNG callback via OQS_randombytes_custom_algorithm(). Embedded build: OQS_BUILD_ONLY_LIB, OQS_EMBEDDED_BUILD.

nodes.label: Zephyr Kconfig Integration
nodes.description: Configurable KEM and SIG algorithm enablement via CONFIG_LIBOQS_ENABLE_* options. NIST-standardized algorithms (ML-KEM, ML-DSA) enabled by default. Other algorithms disabled by default. CROSS variants with large stack usage disabled.

nodes.label: Zephyr Sample Applications
nodes.description: Two sample apps: KEMs (liboqs_kems) and Signatures (liboqs_signatures). Integration platforms: qemu_x86, qemu_cortex_a53, qemu_riscv32, qemu_riscv64. Console harness with 'Test done' verification.

nodes.label: foretias-p2p Python Bindings
nodes.description: Python bindings for Foretias P2P attestation engine via PyO3. Provides PyCryptoServer and related classes for signing/verification from Python. Built with maturin.

nodes.label: CPU Architecture Optimizations
nodes.description: Common optimization variants across all signature schemes: ref (portable C), avx2 (x86 SIMD with -mavx2, -mpopcnt), neon (ARM SIMD), aarch64 (ARM64-specific with NTT). AVX2 variants often include multiplication table optimizations (-D_MUL_WITH_MULTAB_).

nodes.label: Signature Scheme Categories
nodes.description: liboqs organizes signatures into two categories: stateless (SIG) and stateful (SIG_STFL). Stateless: FALCON, MAYO, ML-DSA, SPHINCS+, UOV. Stateful: LMS, XMSS, XMSSMT. Stateless schemes do not require signer state tracking; stateful schemes require counter management.

nodes.label: LMS Cisco License
nodes.description: LMS implementation derived from Cisco Systems code (2017), MIT license. Separate licensing from rest of liboqs which uses MIT/Apache-2.0/CC0-1.0 combinations.

nodes.label: CMake Object Library Pattern
nodes.description: All signature implementations use CMake OBJECT libraries with conditional compilation flags. Object libraries are aggregated into category-level variables (FALCON_OBJS, MAYO_OBJS, etc.) via PARENT_SCOPE. Enables selective inclusion of algorithm variants.

nodes.label: ML-DSA Dilithium Mode Mapping
nodes.description: ML-DSA parameter mapping: ml_dsa_44 uses DILITHIUM_MODE=2, ml_dsa_65 uses DILITHIUM_MODE=3, ml_dsa_87 uses DILITHIUM_MODE=5. Corresponds to NIST security levels 2, 3, 5.

nodes.label: UOV Parameter Convention
nodes.description: UOV variants encode parameters in name: ov_Is (n=16, m=160, o=64), ov_Ip (n=256, m=112, o=44), ov_III (n=256, m=184, o=72), ov_V (n=256, m=244, o=96). Mode suffixes: pkc (public-key), skc (secret-key). Pre-quantum security levels: I (lowest) through V (highest).

nodes.label: XMSS Hash Parameter Mapping
nodes.description: XMSS compile-time hash selection: HASH=1 (sha256 128-bit), HASH=2 (shake256 192-bit), HASH=3 (sha256 256-bit), HASH=4 (shake128 256-bit), HASH=5 (shake256 256-bit), HASH=6 (sha512), HASH=7 (shake256 256-bit). Combined with XMSS_PARAMS_NAMESPACE for each variant.

hyperedges.description: All Rust crates in the p2p/ Cargo workspace
Build order: C11 core first, then core-engine, then foretias-node, then foretias-python and foretias-java
Sequential CI: c11-tests → rust-tests → python-tests, with lint running in parallel
Three time beings communicate via direct method calls within TimeFamilyServer. Only Communerd communicates externally.
Three attacker levels with increasing capability: passive observer, active MITM, compromised legitimate peer
All threats identified in v0.5 threat model with their mitigations
HOWTO.md three escalating demos: single server, 100-node peering with DHT, kill 50% and verify resilience
Four-layer architecture: C11 encode/decode, Rust FFI wrapper, display formatter, CLI integration (Rust + Python + PyO3)
Tasks 1-5 are independent and parallel. Task 6 (Python→Rust migration) depends on everything and requires substantial Rust rewrite
Three transport layers: libp2p Direct (request_response/yamux, libp2p-noise), Noise_XX TCP (custom, C11), libp2p swarm (Kademlia+GossipSub)
JSON-RPC attack surface: no TLS, replay attacks, stamp floods, oversized requests. Mitigated by echo fields, rate limits, MAX_CONTENT_BYTES.
Rename affects all layers: C header and sources, Rust sources and configs, Python sources and tests, spec files, build configs

hyperedges.label: liboqs CI pipeline
hyperedges.description: All CI workflows can be composed together via workflow_call. pr.yml, push.yml, commit-to-main.yml, release.yml, and weekly.yml each compose different subsets.

hyperedges.label: Linux CI build matrix
hyperedges.description: Linux CI tests various combinations of OpenSSL integration, libjade, stateful signatures, algorithm sets, and build modes.

hyperedges.label: Fuzz testing ecosystem
hyperedges.description: Fuzz testing covers 5 sig algorithms currently, with KEM and stateful sig fuzzing pending. basic.yml includes fuzzbuildcheck job.

hyperedges.label: Downstream project ecosystem
hyperedges.description: liboqs is the upstream for 8 downstream projects (BoringSSL, OpenSSH, oqs-provider, C++, Go, Python, Java, Rust bindings). Changes trigger their CI automatically.

properties.description: Code-based cryptography family: BIKE (QC-MDPC), Classic McEliece (binary Goppa), HQC (syndrome decoding)
Lattice-based cryptography family: FrodoKEM (LWE), Kyber/ML-KEM (Module LWE+R), NTRU-Prime (NTRU)
ML-KEM is the only KEM in liboqs implementing a NIST final standard (FIPS 203)
Algorithms that advanced to NIST Round 4
Classic McEliece variants have large stack usage that may cause failures in threads or constrained environments
Classic McEliece implementations may not be constant-time; memory leak issues with clang -O2/-O3 on x86-64
Algorithms with claimed AND valgrind-verified no-secret-dependent-branching across all parameter sets (clean implementations)
Kyber and ML-KEM parameter pairs have identical key/ciphertext sizes - ML-KEM adds keypair_seed_bytes field
Kyber512/ML-KEM-512 (800 bytes) and sntrup761 (1158 bytes) have the smallest public keys among Level 1-2 KEMs, vs BIKE-L1 (1541), HQC-128 (2249), FrodoKEM-640 (9616), Classic-McEliece-348864 (261120)
sntrup761 is included in liboqs only for interop testing, not recommended for production

hyperedges.description: Complete set of key encapsulation mechanisms in liboqs
Signature schemes covered in this build chunk (full liboqs also includes Falcon, SPHINCS+, MAYO, UOV, ML-DSA, XMSS, LMS)
ML-KEM implementations spanning reference C, x86_64 AVX2, AArch64 NEON, and CUDA GPU backends
Kyber and ML-KEM share algorithmic lineage; Kyber team provides AVX2 backend, libjade provides verified assembly
BIKE's security model: QC-MDPC codes, GF2X arithmetic, constant-time BGF decoding, isochronous biased sampling to prevent timing attacks
Symmetric primitive layer: AES/SHA2/SHA3 with OpenSSL or native fallbacks, plus FIPS202 shims for PQClean compatibility
Automated CMake generation: Jinja2 templates produce per-algorithm CMakeLists from metadata, XKCP template produces SHA-3 builds
SHA-3 build chain: XKCP KeccakP-1600 low-level -> common SHA-3 wrappers -> FIPS202 PQClean shims
All PQC signature schemes in liboqs, organized as stateless (SIG) and stateful (SIG_STFL) categories, each with multiple parameter variants and CPU-optimized implementations
Signatures built from PQClean reference implementations, all sharing pqclean_shims common headers and the object library build pattern
Stateful hash-based signatures requiring counter management, with LMS from Cisco and XMSS/XMSSMT from NIST standardization
Complete testing ecosystem: functional tests, known-answer tests, memory tests, speed benchmarks, fuzzing, and constant-time verification
Zephyr RTOS integration package: module definition, Kconfig options, and sample applications for embedded PQC
Algorithms with NIST standardization status: ML-DSA (FIPS 204), SPHINCS+ (FIPS 205), LMS (FIPS 205), XMSS (FIPS 205)
